objective: Rebuild durable team continuity so a seat survives a lost session (Context Rotation).
done_when: Every team a seat is restarted for has a sealed work capsule, an issued writer lease and an event chain in git, and opsctl wake reconstructs it from a clean clone with zero evidence loss.
next_action: Seed one team as a pilot, prove opsctl wake reconstructs it, then extend to the remaining teams.

blocker.summary: The authoritative per-team backlog lived in a physical-ledger workspace (teams/<team>/BACKLOG.json) that is not in this repository and did not survive the originating session. Only the Hub rendered snapshot remains as a source.
